speakers.speaker: spk04

speakers.speaker: spk02

speakers.speaker: spk04
speakers.text: Another question is on the stock-based compensation. Can you quantify roughly how much it is per quarter and what it was in the second quarter and how it is expected to trend in the third and fourth quarters?

speakers.speaker: spk04
speakers.text: So it's 20, 25 million, and you're saying that in the third and fourth quarters, that number is going to go down?

speakers.speaker: spk12

speakers.speaker: spk04
speakers.text: Okay. So the shipment cost on a per watt basis, did the shipment cost go up quarter to quarter on a per watt basis?

speakers.speaker: spk12

speakers.speaker: spk04
speakers.text: Okay. And can you also tell us what the depreciation and capex numbers were for the second quarter and what your expectation is for the full year now?

speakers.speaker: spk08

speakers.speaker: spk02

speakers.speaker: spk04
speakers.text: Thank you, thank you very much.

speakers.speaker: spk02
speakers.text: Thank you. There's a lot of questions. I will try to cover it as much as I can. It's really a benefit-sharing model, which means that approximately, let's say, by using Tiger Neo N-type products, the customer's project can get additional benefit of around... 2.5 to 3 cents per watt, so then we are establishing the business model to share the benefit by approximately half to half with the customer. Even with more and more peers joining the TOPCON group, we believe we can jointly leading the technology innovation and create a bigger market for solar industry. speakers.speaker: spk06
speakers.text: Yeah, okay. Thank you, management. This is very helpful and I'll pass on. Thank you.

speakers.speaker: spk02
speakers.text: Thank you very much.

speakers.speaker: spk01

speakers.speaker: spk12

speakers.text: Okay, thank you. I'll take the rest offline.

speakers.speaker: spk11
speakers.text: Thank you.
